frontmatter.name: visual-diff
frontmatter.description: Screenshot the built site on this branch and on main and pixel-diff them, to catch layout regressions that tests cannot judge. Use after changing shared ui components (Button, Select, TextInput, Modal, Card…), the navbar, the root layout or global styles — especially a11y/markup refactors that move or wrap elements — and before saying a UI change "doesn't break anything".

nodes.label: Modal component
nodes.rationale: Already role=dialog aria-modal=true and closes on Escape — do not build ad-hoc overlays.

nodes.label: TextInput component
nodes.rationale: Uses placeholder as aria-label outside an InputGroup because placeholder alone disappears once typed into.

nodes.label: Colocated context.ts composition
nodes.rationale: InputGroup, Button, Select and Table push sizing/layout down through context — check before adding a prop.

nodes.label: Accessible names for controls
nodes.rationale: Every control needs a name a screen reader can announce; icon-only buttons need aria-label from a11y.* messages.

nodes.label: Semantics before ARIA
nodes.rationale: Clickable things are <button>/<a href>; never onclick on div; never add svelte-ignore a11y_* — fix the markup instead; no nested interactive elements.

nodes.label: src/lib/date.ts date barrel
nodes.rationale: Direct date-fns imports are eslint errors; barrel injects active locale into format helpers so callers never pass one.

nodes.label: Lottie wrapper component (lottie_light)
nodes.rationale: Never import lottie-web in feature code.

nodes.label: MarkdownText component
nodes.rationale: All markdown/remote HTML renders through it (marked + DOMPurify) so untrusted content is never {@html} elsewhere; noSanitize only for static i18n text.

nodes.label: portal action (#lib/utils/portal.ts)
nodes.rationale: Replaces svelte-portal, which must not be reintroduced.

nodes.label: rtDate reactive now (realtimeDate.svelte.ts)
nodes.rationale: Driven by one requestAnimationFrame loop in the root layout; never start your own interval.

nodes.label: GSAP timeline choreography
nodes.rationale: Only for timelines; ScrollTrigger in onMount, gsap.matchMedia default/reduced branches, keep context for cleanup.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS v4 tokens in src/app.css
nodes.norm_label: tailwind css v4 tokens in src/app.css
nodes.rationale: Tokens/variants/plugins in app.css, never a JS config; class names must be complete literal strings.

nodes.label: Banned imports (zod, date-fns, react)
nodes.rationale: eslint no-restricted-imports: zod → zod/mini, date-fns → #lib/date.ts, react banned; type imports allowed.

nodes.label: Explicit import file extensions
nodes.rationale: Every local specifier names the real file; enforced by eslint import-x/extensions; its .js→.ts suggestion appends, fix by hand.

nodes.label: Svelte 5 runes only
nodes.rationale: No $:, export let or slots; use snippets/@render.

nodes.label: createRawSnippet for snippet props
nodes.rationale: mount() never converts plain arrow-function snippet props, so they silently render empty.

nodes.label: E2E smoke suite (vitest.e2e.config.ts)
nodes.rationale: Needs static build; aborts off-origin requests for determinism; axe-core a11y and Tab walk; gates deploy in CI.

nodes.label: pnpm test:e2e (axe-core + keyboard + SEO smoke over build/)
nodes.norm_label: pnpm test:e2e (axe-core + keyboard + seo smoke over build/)

nodes.label: pakop WASM stub for screenshots
nodes.rationale: Without dotnet, a stub dotnet.js is enough to build for screenshots; delete wasm/pakop/bin afterwards.

nodes.label: jsonLd() helper
nodes.rationale: Escapes < so unescaped strings never get interpolated into a <script>.

nodes.label: site.e2e.ts e2e smoke suite
nodes.rationale: Enforces zero axe-core violations (WCAG 2.1 A/AA + best-practice) at 412px and 1440px on every sitemapPaths route, plus SEO head tags; gates deploy in CI, so new routes/menus/overlays extend it instead of manual checks.

nodes.label: sitemapPaths
nodes.rationale: New indexable non-parameterized routes must be added; feeds prerendered /sitemap.xml and the e2e suite.

nodes.label: Inline dark-mode bootstrap script
nodes.rationale: Must stay inline and blocking, otherwise the page flashes before first paint.

nodes.label: $app/env/public
nodes.rationale: Replaces $env/static/public, deprecated since Kit 3.

nodes.label: Four-step env var registration
nodes.rationale: Skipping any step ships an empty string or an unresolvable import.

nodes.label: Static-build constraint
nodes.rationale: Site must stay statically buildable: no server runtime, no server load, no +server.ts.

nodes.label: Build-time env inlining
nodes.rationale: Statically built, no runtime server env; values cannot change after pnpm build.

nodes.label: pnpm format
nodes.rationale: pnpm lint only checks formatting, so format first.

nodes.label: getMtLocale
nodes.rationale: Picks a translation from a game-name table; unrelated to dates.

nodes.label: CI e2e not run by pre-commit
nodes.norm_label: ci e2e not run by pre-commit
nodes.rationale: CI additionally builds and runs pnpm test:e2e; run it yourself after UI or head-tag changes.

nodes.label: Editor.svelte view switching
nodes.rationale: ?view= param with replace goto; earlier shallow-routing modal re-ran close guard every keystroke.

nodes.label: monaco.ts import choke point
nodes.rationale: A second specifier creates a second standalone-API singleton and json diagnostics die silently.

nodes.label: JSON Schema from z.toJSONSchema(trackSchema)
nodes.rationale: Not a second source of truth; safeParse still gates Save.

nodes.label: Managed wasm-safe compression (OodleSharp)
nodes.rationale: Native helpers cannot load on browser wasm

nodes.label: EGame.GAME_UE5_5 version container
nodes.rationale: Some mod assets failed at 5.2

nodes.label: Usmap type mappings provider
nodes.rationale: Stale usmap truncates DataTable rows; fix is refreshing usmap

nodes.label: TrimMode=partial trimming
nodes.rationale: Full trimming drops reflected types like UDataTable

nodes.label: AbstractVfsFileProvider.Mount deadlock
nodes.rationale: Task.Run .Result deadlocks single-threaded wasm

nodes.label: Camera rig with inertial wheel zoom
nodes.norm_label: camera rig with inertial wheel zoom

nodes.label: static/map_tiles colors/heights
nodes.rationale: Plural colors/ dir was the one real port bug

nodes.label: TILES_META bundled tile metadata
nodes.rationale: No fetch, bundled by Vite

nodes.label: dotnetWasmAssetPlugin
nodes.rationale: Must be first Vite plugin: rewrites _framework/** asset imports to ?url and externalizes Node-only imports.

nodes.label: pnpm build:pakop
nodes.rationale: Required after every C# change and on fresh checkout; CI builds once and shares artifact so site build never needs .NET.

nodes.label: Lazy-load pakop via dynamic import
nodes.rationale: Keeps the dotnet runtime out of the main bundle.

nodes.label: ui vs components split
nodes.rationale: Domain-specific code stays out of src/lib/ui so the UI kit stays reusable.

nodes.label: Icon component
nodes.rationale: aria-hidden unless given a title (then role=img).

nodes.label: Icon component
nodes.rationale: class required; Button context overrides size.

nodes.label: Skeleton/loading semantics
nodes.rationale: TextSkeleton/Card loading hidden from AT; loading Card exposes aria-busy + visually hidden status; sizing placeholders stay invisible/inert.

nodes.label: Bundle analyzer (stats.html)
nodes.rationale: applyToEnvironment client-only and absolute fileName prevent a mixed client+server report under Kit 3; skipped when CI is set.

nodes.label: dotnetWasmAssetPlugin()
nodes.rationale: Must stay first in the plugin list.

nodes.label: optimizeDeps.exclude monaco-editor
nodes.rationale: Prebundling fights the lazy Monaco chunk.

nodes.label: WasmBundlerFriendlyBootConfig
nodes.rationale: Vite bundles runtime assets content-hashed, cache-safe

nodes.label: Asset import suffixes (?no-inline, ?url)
nodes.rationale: ?no-inline forces a file URL for head-string assets instead of base64; ?url imports URL of non-JS assets.

nodes.label: Contrast requirements (4.5:1)
nodes.rationale: Brand colours fail easily; Discord #5865f2 replaced by #4e5ae8 bg / #4752c4 text; use -800 text on -800/20 tints.

nodes.label: Keyboard operability
nodes.rationale: Everything mouse-reachable must be Tab-reachable; hover menus open on focus; skip link slides in with translate rather than toggling sr-only to avoid reflow.

nodes.label: src/lib/api/proto/generated/ (pnpm proto:generate)
nodes.rationale: Gitignored; a fresh clone must generate before typecheck/build/test.

nodes.label: lefthook pre-commit hook
nodes.rationale: Piped, sequential jobs gated on staged paths so codegen lands before checks.

nodes.label: graphify-out/graph.json
nodes.rationale: Only committed graphify output; CI rebuilds code layer on push to main, but doc/image nodes need a local LLM pass (/graphify . --update).

nodes.label: m from #messages
nodes.rationale: Bracket syntax for namespaced keys; parameterized messages take one object; usable in .ts (zod error factories, head tags).

nodes.label: Node subpath imports (#lib, #messages)
nodes.rationale: Kit 3 dropped $lib and deprecated kit.alias; no tsconfig paths.

nodes.label: Query options factory + createQuery wrapper
nodes.rationale: Getter input avoids snapshotting $state

nodes.label: serve.mjs (SPA-fallback static server)
nodes.rationale: Fresh server per build because vite preview keeps serving the old asset list after rebuild and stylesheets 404.

nodes.label: Select overflow regression example
nodes.rationale: Moving an input out of a w-full button made the Select overflow its container — the motivating layout regression.

nodes.label: Visual diff skill
nodes.rationale: Tests and e2e cannot judge whether a page still looks right; markup refactors routinely change layout, so a before/after pixel comparison with human judgement is needed.

nodes.label: Judge every diff (live data is not a regression)
nodes.norm_label: judge every diff (live data is not a regression)
nodes.rationale: Live data (player counts, timers, map markers, home video frame) differs between runs; every other difference must be explained by an intended change.

nodes.norm_label: styling: tailwind full class strings only
nodes.rationale: Tailwind only generates classes found as complete strings in src/, so class names must never be built by concatenation.

nodes.label: reProjectPoint / reProjectVec2 / reProjectPointInverse
nodes.rationale: Game coordinates are not map coordinates; raw game coords render off-map.

nodes.label: TILES_META (heightmap.ts)

nodes.label: Instanced dot sprites with three-cell atlas
nodes.norm_label: instanced dot sprites with three-cell atlas
nodes.rationale: Single-texture instancing per palette keeps it reliable.

nodes.label: ol/source barrel eslint ban
nodes.rationale: Barrel pulls ol/source/GeoTIFF -> web-worker which throws in the SvelteKit prerender worker; keeps Map.svelte a static import.

nodes.label: One-way data flow
nodes.rationale: Map.svelte never reaches into the map; actions become props, user input returns via onHover/onClick/onRightClick callbacks; ol observes its own target size.

nodes.label: Selection is the URL
nodes.rationale: Selection derived from search params (house, delivery, player, focus_index); view-on-map just navigates; never centre imperatively.

nodes.label: OL-compatible callback bridge
nodes.rationale: Parity lets Map.svelte tooltip/panels/click semantics stay wrapper-agnostic.

nodes.label: Coarse-to-fine swap invariant
nodes.rationale: Coarse ancestor stays mounted until all four finer replacements load so zoom never flashes a hole.

nodes.label: project.inlang/settings.json locales
nodes.rationale: Locales parked in __unused_* are not compiled; missing keys fall back to en.

nodes.label: Accessible by default
nodes.rationale: Every control has an accessible name; svelte-ignore a11y_* is not a fix.

nodes.label: Never hand-edit generated trees (paraglide, proto generated, pakop bin/obj)
nodes.norm_label: never hand-edit generated trees (paraglide, proto generated, pakop bin/obj)
